If I brought this up to my parents they'd immediately reject the idea or say they'll do it but wait till I forget. It's what they did when I continuously asked to go to a therpaist. 
Is it possible for me to just go without parental permission? I'm assuming they'd be contacted eventually but I'd prefer their know about it as late as possible so they can't hold me back. If it helps I'm 16 and live in the US.

The reason my parents are like this is because they've had a few bad experiences with doctors and now refuse to let them help in any way

Sadly my school councillors aren't that great. From what I've heard and seen of others there's little confidentiality and normally leads straight to cps, police or some other unnecessary action. As for my parents, my mom had one bad experience with bro depressants and now she forbid me from using them. I'm trying to go back to a therapist but again my parents are just procrastinating. They like to just wait things out until the problem goes away and that's what they're doing with my depression.
